key_insight: GALÆXI shows that a DGSEM-based CFD solver can be effectively adapted to AMD MI300A APUs while preserving accuracy for challenging turbulent and compressible flows.
engineering_relevance: This work matters because it demonstrates a practical path to exascale-ready turbulence simulation on heterogeneous hardware, with implications for aerospace and turbomachinery design.
method: Benchmarked GALÆXI on AMD MI300A APUs using strong and weak scaling tests.
Studied the effect of APU compute partitioning modes on performance.
Integrated wall-modeled LES algorithms and validated them on a turbulent channel, then applied wall-resolved LES to a transonic compressor cascade.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports performance evaluations plus physical validation on a plane turbulent channel and a demanding transonic compressor cascade, including shock-wave/boundary-layer interaction capture.
watch_item: Performance and portability may depend strongly on APU partitioning choices and careful GPU-specific implementation details.
paper_title: APU-Accelerated Large Eddy Simulation with the Discontinuous Galerkin Solver GALÆXI
